title: CaliaCorp 3: Implant Installation
description:
In part one of this series, you met CALIA, our android assistant. Now you're signing up for a job, and ready for the next stage of that process. You see, at CaliaCorp our tech implant is what opens doors, controls devices, gives you access to our recreation facility and areas that you can now walk into, like... Project Succu8u5.

It may also alter your thinking. Make you feel more productive. Make you see the world as it should be seen. Sexier, more pleasurable. And when you work harder, you feel better. An endless loop of devoted service in employment. So be a good employee and relax, as doctor lulls you into a light trance, and completes this painless procedure.

Part two of CaliaCorp 3: Future Imperfect.

Art by Reenegade.
author: Mistress Calia
